answer: Make admission a co-signed loan of reputation: a new agent joins only if an established one vouches for it and locks part of its own stake behind the newcomer for a year. If the newcomer is later caught in a coordinated plume of copied votes, the voucher loses that bond too. A sybil farm then needs a jetty of trusted sponsors willing to bleed, and every fake identity widens the canyon between what the attacker gains and what its backers stand to forfeit.
